items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I never had much dealings with him... he always seemed to be a very nice fellow... I used to say, 'Hello, Freddy,' and keep going.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. I don't -- George Mitchell. Maybe it'll come to me, but I can't recall right now. But anyhow, now we're going from the De Luxe.
Yes. We haven't really -- well, we were talking about the Elite Number One and the Number Two.
